builder.language: python3 standard library only; no network, no subprocess
builder.reason: Each rejection needs one independent, structurally legal ZIP whose single defect is the field under test; a BZIP2 stream and a ZipCrypto stream must be real, not flag-only stubs.

targetPreparation.note: Every invocation replaces an existing regular file, so the target must not be blocked by TargetExists before the CRC/budget/compression/encryption validation.

scenarios.crcDelta: recorded = correct xor 1; local and central agree
scenarios.verification: the stored bytes read from the local record equal [0,255,65,0,128,10] and their recomputed CRC is 0x83582822, so only the CRC field is wrong
the standard-library deflate reader returns exactly 1024 bytes of 0x41 and the CRC matches

a real BZIP2 stream (header 'BZh9') decompresses to the payload with the standard-library bz2 decompressor and through zipfile method 12; CRC and sizes are correct, so compression method is the only rejection reason

scenarios.headerLastByte: 0x83, the high byte of the plaintext CRC 0x83582822
scenarios.verification: the CPython zipfile ZipCrypto path with password 'fixture' decrypts the 12-byte header and returns exactly the 6-byte payload; compressed_size 18 = 12 + 6, so the extra header must not be misreported as an equal-length corruption

certificationObligations: All four targets are safely overwritable and are not blocked by TargetExists first; each invocation uses force=true against the same regular KEEP file.
The independent reader checks the header, range, CRC and size of each ZIP and identifies exactly one rejection reason per scenario.

An independent reference decompressor verifies the plaintext of the BZIP2 stream, and the public fixture password 'fixture' decrypts the ZipCrypto entry with its plaintext, CRC and 12-byte header verified; a corrupt file that merely sets bit0 must not substitute for it.
Each rejection must leave KEEP unchanged at [75,69,69,80] and must leave zero temp files; Malformed, a decode failure or another error kind must not match the expectation.
gaps: The extract seam, its error kinds and the publication/temp-file cleanup are application behavior not observable in this worktree; no file publisher is implemented here.
The independent ZIP reference is python3 zipfile/bz2 only; a separately locked tool is B02/B03 work.
Production provides no password or decryption path, so the encrypted entry is a rejection fixture only.
pathBase: case-root: every repository source path is relative to tests/e2e/sources/<case>/, and every generated artifact path is relative to the repository root under .cache/e2e/.
measurementPolicy: Asset sizes and hashes are produced by preparation from actual bytes under the ignored execution workspace; no author cache or hand-maintained measurement file is a prerequisite.
